correctness.rationale: The four pair-state matrices A0,A1 count every indexed cyclic input with fixed one-step Rule22 output by trace product; cyclic rotation allows any nonzero output to end in A1. The coordinatewise envelope of arbitrary A0/A1 row-products reaches (1,1,1,1) after two steps from each unit row and follows (a,a,b,c)->(b,b,c,a+c), bounding every nonzero fiber by u_n=2a_{n-1}+b_{n-1}. The zero-output trace gives P_n(0^n)=1+tr(B^n)=1+t_n with t_0=3,t_1=t_2=1 and t_n=t_{n-1}+t_{n-3}. Both u and t satisfy same recurrence, differences at n=3,4,5 are 1,2,2, so remain >0 for every n>=3. Independently enumerated all inputs for rings n=3..12, maximum fibers 5,6,7,11,16,22,32,47,68,99, unique at zero. The all-length result follows from matrix induction, not this finite census.
